title: Lecturer on Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology
bio: Dr. Leonard Brennan is co-director of Harvard School of Dental Medicine's Geriatric Fellowship Program and a part-time lecturer in the Department of Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology. He also serves as the geriatric adviser and a lead for Harvard's National Center for Equitable Care for Elders .
